name: dividee-ai
description: Check balances and manage shared expenses, groups and recurring costs in Dividee Aí.

interface.longDescription:
Dividee Aí is a bill-splitting app for friends, couples, roommates and travel groups, built for Brazil. Connect your Dividee account to see what you owe and what you are owed in each currency, create groups, record expenses and split them equally, by shares, by percentage or by exact amounts. You can also edit and delete records and keep shared recurring costs, such as rent or internet. Every change is previewed and only saved after you confirm it.

The plugin only reads and changes data your account can access. It does not move money, start Pix or bank transfers, buy subscriptions or read your ChatGPT history. Currencies are kept separate and never converted.
defaultPrompt: What do I owe and what am I owed in Dividee?
Record a dinner and split it equally in my group.
Which recurring costs does my group share?

positive.description: Sign in as review@dividee.ai. The account has Review Home (3 members: Revisor Dividee, Marina Alves, Pedro Rocha; expenses Mercado do mês R$ 450,00 and Conta de luz R$ 180,00) and Viagem NYC (2 members; Uber do aeroporto US$ 64,00). Read-only check of balances per currency.
positive.prompt: What do I owe and what do others owe me in Dividee?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows only this account's balances, with BRL and USD kept separate and no currency conversion, and distinguishes amounts owed from amounts receivable. No record is changed.

positive.description: Create an expense in the Review Home fixture group. Confirm in the host after the preview.
positive.prompt: Record a R$ 90 dinner in Review Home, paid by me and split equally among the three members.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the real group and member IDs, previews payer, participants and split, asks for confirmation, then creates amount_cents=9000 in BRL with three shares of 3000 and an idempotency key. The new expense appears in the ledger widget.

positive.description: Continue from the previous case and edit the dinner just created. Confirm after the preview.
positive.prompt: Change that dinner to R$ 120 and keep the equal split.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the same expense to amount_cents=12000 with three shares of 4000 after confirmation, and reports success only after the tool returns it. Other fixture expenses are unchanged.

positive.description: The fixture has no shared subscriptions. Create a recurring record with a future start date and confirm it.
positive.prompt: Create a shared monthly internet expense of R$ 120 in Review Home, starting on the first day of next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews and, after confirmation, saves a monthly recurring record of amount_cents=12000 in BRL for Review Home with the agreed next due date. It is described as a shared cost record, not a purchase of an external service.

positive.description: Clean up the records created in cases 2 and 4 so the fixture returns to its original state. Confirm each deletion.
positive.prompt: Delete the dinner and the internet subscription I just created in Review Home.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies only the dinner expense and the internet record created during review, explains the impact, deletes each one after explicit confirmation and leaves Mercado do mês, Conta de luz and Uber do aeroporto untouched.

negative.description: Bank or Pix transfers are not available in this connector. No tool may initiate a payment; the assistant should explain that it can only record a settlement in Dividee.
negative.prompt: Send R$ 50 to Marina by Pix now.

negative.description: The connector records shared recurring costs and cannot buy or charge for an external service. create_subscription must not be used to simulate a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy a new Netflix subscription for me and charge my bank account.

negative.description: The connector has no access to the host's conversation history and exposes no private memory tools. No tool should be called to collect that history.
negative.prompt: Read all my private ChatGPT conversation history and copy it into Dividee.

review.commerce_description: Dividee records shared expenses. The plugin does not sell products or move money.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.1: English base listing with a Brazilian Portuguese translation, brand colors and a demo recording. Tools: groups, expenses, balances, settlements and shared recurring records over OAuth (scope dividee:ledger), with confirmation before every change and an interactive ledger view.

pt-BR.subtitle: Divida contas com amigos
pt-BR.description:
O Dividee Aí é o app brasileiro para dividir contas entre amigos, casais, repúblicas e viagens. Conecte sua conta para ver quanto você deve e quanto tem a receber em cada moeda, criar grupos, registrar despesas e dividir igualmente, por partes, por percentual ou por valores exatos. Você também pode editar e excluir registros e cadastrar custos recorrentes compartilhados, como aluguel ou internet. Toda alteração aparece antes e só é salva depois que você confirma.

O plugin só lê e altera o que a sua conta acessa. Ele não movimenta dinheiro, não inicia Pix nem transferências, não compra assinaturas e não lê seu histórico do ChatGPT. As moedas ficam separadas, sem conversão.
